name: Santa
shape_prompt: Stylized 3D game character, chunky vinyl-toy style, smooth sculpted rounded forms, soft simple shapes, quirky proportions. A scruffy, grumpy Santa Claus: short and round with a big pot belly, slightly hunched. Big head, furrowed bushy eyebrows, frowning grumpy face, round nose, messy uneven beard. Suit with a few sewn-on fabric patches with visible stitching, thick fur trim, belt with a crooked buckle. Floppy hat tilted sideways with a droopy tip and a fluffy pompom. Worn boots and mittens. Full body, standing, A-pose, arms slightly out from the body, hands separate from the belly, legs slightly apart, single character, no base, no props.
texture_prompt: Bright saturated colours, smooth soft vinyl-toy finish, clean hand-painted look. Faded red suit with a few darker muted red and brown fabric patches with visible stitching (patches must not look like presents). Off-white fur trim, slightly grubby. Black belt with a crooked gold buckle. Rosy round nose and rosy cheeks, grey-white messy beard and bushy grey eyebrows. Floppy red hat with off-white fur band and white pompom. Worn brown boots and brown mittens. No text, no logos.

assemble._note: The player character (StarterCharacter). Faces +Z in Meshy; yaw 180 to face -Z. Root 2x2x1 at the pivot, hip 2, so feet are 3 studs below the root centre; 5.5 studs tall (a bit taller than a default avatar, he's round).

animations._note: Meshy animation library clips on Santa's rig (3 credits each). Keys are the names the game plays (src/client/SantaAnimate.client.luau, src/shared/SantaMoves.luau); values are the clip names in Meshy's GLB.
